cover: Single sign-on, explained for growing companies

slides.title: One login for every tool
slides.body: Staff sign in once with their company account. Each app trusts the identity provider and never sees the password.

slides.title: Offboarding in one step
slides.body: Disable one account and the person is locked out of every connected app, with no list of tools to remember.

slides.title: Security rules set once
slides.body: Require a second factor in the identity provider and every connected app inherits it.

slides.title: Sign-in isn't provisioning
slides.body: SSO may not remove accounts inside each app. SCIM does that automatically. Ask vendors about both.

slides.title: Before you buy, ask
slides.body: Is SSO on our plan or only a higher one? Can we turn off password login so SSO is the only way in?
